mapper.select: SELECT R.RNO, R.COMPANY, R.EMP, R.ONO, U.NAME, U.BIRTHDATE FROM TBL_ROOM R JOIN TBL_USER U ON R.EMP = U.UNO WHERE R.COMPANY = #{cno}
SELECT r.RNO, r.COMPANY, r.EMP, r.ONO, c.corpNm FROM TBL_ROOM r LEFT JOIN TBL_CINFO c ON r.COMPANY = c.uno WHERE r.EMP = #{uno}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_CHATLOG (CLNO, RNO, SENDER, CONTENT, HIT, CL_REGDATE) VALUES (SEQ_CLNO.NEXTVAL, #{rno}, #{sender}, #{content}, #{hit}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT CLNO, RNO, SENDER, CONTENT, HIT, CL_REGDATE FROM TBL_CHATLOG WHERE RNO = #{rno} ORDER BY CL_REGDATE ASC, CLNO ASC

mapper.select: SELECT uc.*, u1.name AS leader_name, u2.name AS member_name FROM tbl_userchat uc LEFT JOIN tbl_user u1 ON uc.leader = u1.uno LEFT JOIN tbl_user u2 ON uc.member = u2.uno WHERE uc.sch_date >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1) ORDER BY uc.r_regdate DESC

SELECT uc.*, u1.name AS leader_name, u2.name AS member_name FROM tbl_userchat uc LEFT JOIN tbl_user u1 ON uc.leader = u1.uno LEFT JOIN tbl_user u2 ON uc.member = u2.uno WHERE uc.r_tag = #{r_tag} AND uc.sch_date >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1) ORDER BY uc.r_regdate DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_userchat SET leader = member, member = null, r_regdate = sysdate WHERE cno = #{cno}
